_source: Inspect lines from rsprox.net index recordings: the item's object box (193) with its line, the line also going to the chat as a mesbox. Rev 235: Stormy key rec 856 t1247, 3461 t1950, 3457 t496; Fetid key rec 908; Serrated key rec 936; Barrel stand recs 3457, 3461; Bottled storm rec 937; Captured wind mote rec 908 t9647; Gurtob's fabric roll rec 908 t9638; Gwyna's fabric roll rec 936 t15961; Ralph's fabric roll rec 3461 t1089, t1945; Heart of Ithell rec 936 t5134, t15957. Rev 226: the three unscented vyre noble pieces rec 1637 t4660-4661.
Stormy key: As you inspect the key, a tingling sensation shoots up your arm. You feel charged and ready to explore for the lock it opens.
Fetid key: As you inspect the key, an acrid aroma fills the air. Hopefully it won't take too long to find what it opens.
Serrated key: As you inspect the key you almost cut yourself on its sharp edges. Whoever created it clearly didn't intend for it to be used easily.
Barrel stand: A collection of oak and steel of exquisite craftsmanship, built to withstand the harsh conditions at sea. It can be used to build a barrel stand on a boat.
Bottled storm: The container shakes violently, thrumming with magical energy. You reckon it might be useful for shipbuilding.
Captured wind mote: The jar thrums as the mote feverently tries to escape its container, almost slipping from your hand as you inspect it. It can be used to make a wind catcher on a boat.
Gurtob's fabric roll: A fabulous roll of fabric awarded to those who have achieved the marlin rank at the Jubbly Jive Barracuda Trial. This would make a fine flag to showcase on a boat.
Gwyna's fabric roll: An elegant roll of fabric awarded to those who have achieved the marlin rank at the Gwenith Glide Barracuda trial. This would make a fine flag to showcase on a boat.
Ralph's fabric roll: An intricate roll of fabric awarded to those who have achieved the marlin rank at the Tempor Tantrum Barracuda Trial. This would make a fine flag to showcase on a boat.
Heart of Ithell: The crystal crackles periodically at a rhythmic rate, reminscent of a slow heartbeat. It can be used to make a crystal extractor on a boat.
Vyre noble top (unscented): The top of a vyre noble disguise. It needs to be scented with vampyre blood before it can be used.
Vyre noble legs (unscented): The legs of a vyre noble disguise. They need to be scented with vampyre blood before they can be used.
Vyre noble shoes (unscented): The shoes of a vyre noble disguise. They need to be scented with vampyre blood before they can be used.
